research.title: Object Detection Robustness Under Image Degradation
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare detector sensitivity to synthetic blur, compression artifacts, and reduced illumination using controlled image transformations.
Evaluated pretrained detectors across degradation settings, examined missed detections by object size, and documented preprocessing choices for reproducible comparisons.

research.title: Data Augmentation for Limited-Label Image Segmentation
bullets: Planned supervised comparisons of geometric and photometric augmentation with supervisor guidance, holding training splits and segmentation architectures fixed.
Trained segmentation baselines in PyTorch, inspected boundary errors, and compared overlap metrics across augmentation settings and labeled training subsets.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded stock discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items to the appropriate staff.
Maintained order paperwork, organized storage areas, and coordinated routine collection schedules while updating colleagues on outstanding requests and delivery changes.

projects.title: Handcrafted Features and Convolutional Models for Image Classification
bullets: Implemented histogram of oriented gradients features with a linear classifier and a small convolutional network for the same image classification task.
Compared classification accuracy and confusion patterns using shared data splits, and examined errors associated with background clutter and viewpoint changes.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Stereo Matching Costs
bullets: Implemented block matching with absolute intensity differences and normalized cross correlation to estimate disparity from rectified stereo image pairs.
Compared disparity errors across window sizes and inspected failure cases near occlusions, repetitive textures, and depth boundaries using reference disparity maps.
